import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# --- Data Preparation ---
# Calculate total spending on different categories
spending_cols = [col for col in df.columns if 'Mnt' in col]
df['Total_Spending'] = df[spending_cols].sum(axis=1)

# Create an Age column from Year_Birth
current_year = pd.to_datetime('today').year
df['Age'] = current_year - df['Year_Birth']

# Create a 'Children' column for total kids and teens
df['Children'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']

# Create a categorical 'Has_Children' column
df['Has_Children'] = np.where(df['Children'] > 0, 'With Children', 'No Children')

# Drop outliers for a clearer visualization (based on common practice with this dataset)
df = df[df['Income'] < 200000]
df = df[df['Age'] < 90]

# --- Visualization ---
# Create a figure with a specific size and style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create the scatter plot using seaborn
scatter = sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Income',
    y='Total_Spending',
    hue='Has_Children',
    size='Age',
    palette={'No Children': '#1f77b4', 'With Children': '#ff7f0e'},
    sizes=(20, 250),
    alpha=0.7,
    edgecolor='black',
    linewidth=0.5,
    ax=ax
)

# --- Annotations and Labels ---
# Set the title and axis labels
ax.set_title('Customer Spending Profile: Income, Age, and Household Composition', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', pad=20)
ax.set_xlabel('Annual Household Income ($)', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Total Spending on Products ($)', fontsize=12)

# Format axis ticks to be more readable
ax.get_xaxis().set_major_formatter(plt.FuncFormatter(lambda x, loc: "${:,.0f}".format(x)))
ax.get_yaxis().set_major_formatter(plt.FuncFormatter(lambda x, loc: "${:,.0f}".format(x)))

# Customize the legend
handles, labels = scatter.get_legend_handles_labels()
# Separate hue and size legends
hue_legend = plt.legend(handles=handles[1:3], labels=labels[1:3], title='Household Status', loc='upper left')
ax.add_artist(hue_legend) # Add the first legend back to the plot
size_legend = plt.legend(handles=handles[3:], labels=labels[3:], title='Customer Age', loc='lower right',
                         label_spacing=1.2, borderpad=1)


# Add an annotation to highlight a key insight
ax.annotate(
    'Higher income customers without children\n a key high-spending segment',
    xy=(85000, 2000),
    xytext=(95000, 1000),
    arrowprops=dict(facecolor='black', shrink=0.05, width=1, headwidth=8),
    fontsize=10,
    bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.3", fc="aliceblue", ec="grey", lw=1)
)

# Final adjustments
plt.grid(True, which='both', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5)
fig.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
